meta.spawn: player reset to x=180 via scene.newPlayerRuntime.resetForRespawn() before replay
meta.purpose: base and Speedster dash trace: 2 idle frames to settle after the reset (folded into this one replay call so no real animation frame can sneak in between a separate settle step and the dash, since `window.stepFrames` re-arms the loop between top-level calls), then hold moveRight+dash for 7 frames. A fresh input edge takes one frame to reach the body, so only 6 of the 7 held frames move at top speed; the final vx is the dash's top speed and the final x (6 frames' worth of travel) is asserted within 2px of a recorded reference.
